name: PwrQ
old_description: Same products. Same solutions. Now backed by the speed of Forgent.
about:
PwrQ operates from Hanover, Maryland, tracing its roots to 1926. The company is now a subsidiary of Forgent, which brought together over a century of power‑systems experience to address modern infrastructure challenges. No individual founders are named in the available sources.

The firm designs and manufactures low‑voltage power distribution equipment — including S1 switchboards, remote power panels (RPP), panelboards, power distribution units (PDU), and automatic transfer switches — through vertically integrated facilities that handle copper busbar fabrication, CNC turret punching, laser cutting, robotic welding, and final assembly and test. Dedicated production lanes for each product family enable high‑volume, high‑precision output. In‑house electrical and application engineering teams perform power‑systems engineering, reliability studies, short‑circuit coordination, arc‑flash analysis, and SCADA/BMS integration. Field services cover preventive maintenance, inspection and testing of medium‑ and low‑voltage switchgear, breakers, relays, and transformers, as well as generator solutions ranging from 3 kW to 10 MW with paralleling and microgrid controls.

PwrQ serves hyperscale data centers, manufacturing plants, utility grids, hospital campuses, and other mission‑critical industrial facilities where uptime and scalability are essential. Its engineering approach spans the full single‑line diagram from utility entrance to rack‑level load, and its service teams are strategically positioned for national and global response.

The company emphasizes that vertical integration gives it control over product development, quality, lead times, and capacity; dedicated lanes and AI‑driven machinery ensure consistency at speed; and its combined product, engineering, and field‑service portfolio allows end‑to‑end delivery without reliance on third‑party vendors.
